t: Suitable for gardening and landscaping professionals. Ideal for branch pruning/limbing, brush clearing and shrubbing. Metal bucking strips and tree hook for durable cutting grip. The 200mm bar with the low kickback auto-oiling chain provides enhanced safety and a smooth cutting performance. Dual switch reduces the risk of accidentally starting up the machine. 2m pole length is extendable up to 3m giving a total reach of 4.5 metres when held at chest level.
